newsitem.title: USA: Imation trims Q4 loss as revenues climb.
newsitem.headline: Imation trims Q4 loss as revenues climb.

text.p: Imation Corp said Tuesday said increased customer demand in the fourth quarter ended December 31 helped the company trim its losses in the period.

Imation, which was spun off from Minnesota Mining and Manufacturing Co in July of 1996, posted a loss of $600,000 compared with a loss of $87.5 million one year ago after a restructuring and other charges.
The 1995 figure also included an operating income loss of $163.9 million, Imation said.
Revenues in the fourth quarter reached $581.6 million, versus $557.7 million in the fourth quarter of 1995.
Imation supplies products and services to the imaging and information industry.
Its shares were trading off 1/2 Tuesday at 29-1/8.
